= camel cmd chaos

Inject faults into a running Camel integration and report how it coped (prototype, dev/test only, needs camel-chaos)


== Usage

[source,bash]
----
camel cmd chaos [options]
----



== Options

[cols="2,5,1,2",options="header"]
|===
| Option | Description | Default | Type
| `--at-call` | Stall rule with a pattern: the matching call that suspends the route (default 1) |  | String
| `--calls` | The rule applies to the next N matching calls |  | String
| `--command` | report, add, remove, clear, reset or expect | report | String
| `--count` | Expect: how many more exchanges the route must complete |  | String
| `--delay` | Latency in millis (latency rule) |  | String
| `--duration` | Rule lifetime in millis |  | String
| `--exception` | Exception class to throw (fail rule) |  | String
| `--id` | Rule id (add: optional, remove: required) |  | String
| `--json` | Output the full report as JSON |  | boolean
| `--pattern` | Endpoint pattern for fail and latency rules |  | String
| `--probability` | 0..1 or a percentage such as 30% |  | String
| `--route-id` | Route id for a stall rule |  | String
| `--timeout` | How long to wait for the integration to answer, in millis or as a duration such as 30s | 10000 | long
| `--type` | Rule type for add: fail, latency or stall |  | String
| `-h,--help` | Display the help and sub-commands |  | boolean
|===
